detail: All seven criteria fail: the render reads as flat vector placeholders (striped, scribbled ellipse turtle, ruled overlay shafts, uniform bokeh) in water that is too bright at t=0.8 and grey-warm at t=3.2/5.4, with no caustic key, no sand, and no rack focus to near-lens snow. The plates show a teal-green shell while the brief and DESIGN ask for amber as the only warm accent, so a human should confirm which shell colour is the target.
